title: Distributed Multimedia Systems: Main Exam, 17 August 2021
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain the three key parameters to consider when evaluating a compression system.
Distinguish between the following.
Multimedia and multimedia systems
Discrete and continuous media
Analog and digital signals
Describe five desirable features for a distributed multimedia system.
Briefly discuss four elements of multimedia.
What are the main issues the user interface designer should keep in mind when he wants to design effective human-computer interaction?
Explain how one can use the three types of text in multimedia.
Briefly describe 5 technical and content design considerations in multimedia information systems.
Describe 4 hardware devices used in virtual environments, clearly explaining the function of each.
Describe principles of animation.
What is synchronization? Explain three basic synchronization issues.
What is compression? Distinguish between lossy and lossless compression.
How does communication bandwidth affect the selection and format of multimedia content?

With the advancing technology, for a company to introduce multimedia computing, a large number of new requirements on distributed systems are required. Briefly explain any three requirements of distributed multimedia applications.
Compare digital audio and MIDI.
Mention three real-time video compression algorithms.
What are the benefits of multimedia distributed systems to an organization?
Outline any four different software that can be used for recording and editing audio.
Distinguish between kinematics and morphing.
Discuss the various types of connecting devices.
What is an authoring system?
Distinguish between source, entropy and hybrid coding as used in multimedia systems.
With use of an example, describe the repetitive sequence suppression form of lossless compression algorithms.
Explain the meaning of human interface-application QoS.
